mapper.select: select tpl_id as id, tpl_code as code, tpl_title as title, tpl_content as content, tpl_channel as channel, tpl_status as status, case when tpl_company_id = 0 then 1 else 0 end as readonly from t_msg_template where tpl_company_id in (0, #{companyId}) order by tpl_id
mapper.insert: insert into t_msg_template (tpl_code, tpl_company_id, tpl_title, tpl_content, tpl_channel, tpl_status) values (#{code}, #{companyId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{channel}, 1)
mapper.delete: delete from t_msg_template where tpl_id = #{id} and tpl_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: select d.dept_id as id, d.parent_id as parentId, d.dept_name as name, d.leader as leader, d.order_num as orderNum, d.status as status, (select count(*) from t_cmp_binding b where b.bnd_company_id = d.company_id and b.bnd_department = d.dept_name and b.bnd_status = 1) as members, (select count(*) from t_pos p where p.pos_company_id = d.company_id and p.pos_status = 1 and p.pos_department = d.dept_name) as jobs from t_cmp_dept d where d.company_id = #{companyId} order by d.parent_id, d.order_num
select count(*) from t_cmp_dept where company_id = #{companyId}
select count(*) from t_cmp_binding where bnd_company_id = #{companyId} and bnd_status = 1
select count(*) from t_pos where pos_company_id = #{companyId} and pos_status = 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_cmp_dept (company_id, parent_id, dept_name, leader, order_num) values (#{companyId}, #{parentId}, #{deptName}, #{leader}, #{orderNum})
mapper.delete: delete from t_cmp_dept where dept_id = #{id} and company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from t_cmp_dept where parent_id = #{id}

select count(*) from t_cmp_binding b join t_cmp_dept d on d.dept_name = b.bnd_department and d.company_id = b.bnd_company_id where d.dept_id = #{id} and b.bnd_company_id = #{companyId} and b.bnd_status = 1
select provider_code as provider, status as status, config_json as configJson, date_format(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as updatedAt from t_cmp_integration where company_id = #{companyId}

select u.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as nickName, u.user_name as userName, b.bnd_department as dept, b.bnd_job_title as jobTitle, (select r.role_id from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = u.user_id and r.role_id in (101,102,103) limit 1) as roleId, case when u.status = '0' then 1 else 0 end as enabled from t_cmp_binding b join sys_user u on u.user_id = b.bnd_user_id where b.bnd_company_id = #{companyId} and u.del_flag = '0' order by u.user_id
mapper.delete: delete from sys_user_role where user_id = #{userId} and role_id in (101, 102, 103)
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (user_name, nick_name, email, password, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, user_type) values (#{userName}, #{nickName}, #{email}, #{password}, '0', '0', 'enterprise', now(), '01')
mapper.select: select user_id from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_cmp_binding (bnd_user_id, bnd_company_id, bnd_job_title, bnd_department, bnd_status, bnd_created_at, bnd_updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{companyId}, #{jobTitle}, #{jobTitle}, 1, now(), now())
mapper.select: select config_value from sys_config where config_key = #{key} limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_config set config_value = #{value} where config_key = #{key}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_config (config_name, config_key, config_value, config_type, create_by, create_time) values (#{name}, #{key}, #{value}, 'Y', 'enterprise', now())
mapper.select: select u.nick_name as candidateName, p.pos_title as positionTitle, t.tal_status as status, date_format(t.tal_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as createdAt from t_tal t join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id left join t_process_instance i on i.pin_id = t.tal_process_instance_id left join t_pos p on p.pos_id = i.pin_position_id where t.tal_company_id = #{companyId} order by t.tal_created_at desc

select t.tal_id as talId, u.nick_name as candidateName from t_tal t join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where t.tal_company_id = #{companyId} and t.tal_status in (3, 4) and t.tal_updated_at < date_sub(now(), interval #{years} year)
mapper.delete: delete from t_tal_status_log where tsl_candidate_id in #{tid}
delete from t_tal where tal_company_id = #{companyId} and tal_id in #{tid}
mapper.select: select cmp_id as "id", cmp_name as name, cmp_industry as industry, cmp_size as size, cmp_city as city, cmp_address as address, cmp_website as website, cmp_intro as intro, cmp_logo_url as "logoUrl", cmp_verify_status as "verifyStatus", cmp_status as status from t_cmp where cmp_id = #{companyId}
mapper.update: update t_cmp set cmp_name = #{name}, cmp_industry = #{industry}, cmp_size = #{size}, cmp_city = #{city}, cmp_address = #{address}, cmp_website = #{website}, cmp_intro = #{intro}, cmp_logo_url = #{logoUrl}, cmp_updated_at = now() where cmp_id = #{companyId}
